title: Deferred-swap KV chunk rotation and cooperative batch-affinity eviction
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a paged/blocked KV cache runtime that reduces costly GPU host swap churn by rotating contiguous KV chunks ("chunks") with a deferred-swap controller. The approach focuses on: 1) grouping KV entries into chunk boundaries aligned with batching affinities, 2) deferring low-probability swap-outs until safe coherence points, and 3) coordinating background host<->GPU transfer (spillstreams) with request batch scheduling to avoid blocking hot request paths. This ticket covers design, simulation, prototype implementation, and observability hooks for rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype implements chunk-based residency bookkeeping with atomic chunk state transitions (HOT, WARM, STAGED, EVICTING)
Deferred-swap controller delays GPU-to-host swap for chunks if predicted reuse within configurable horizon >= 200ms (configurable policy)
End-to-end test demonstrates <=5% tail-latency regressions at 95th percentile under 1.5x baseline load compared to existing LRU-based eviction
Memory accounting shows >=18% reduction in host<->GPU transfer volume for mixed chat+completion workload in our synthetic replay tests
Observability: per-chunk metrics (residency_time_ms, demotion_reason, reuse_estimate) are emitted and visualized in Console dashboard prototype
implementation_notes: Chunking: divide KV address space into 64KB-aligned chunks by default. Chunk size is tunable at runtime schema.
Affinity tagging: when a batch allocates KV slots, mark the associated chunk with batch_affinity token to bias future prefetch/retention decisions.

Deferred-swap controller: maintain a small priority queue of candidate chunks for eviction. Before issuing a swap, consult a micro-simulator that consumes recent batch traces to estimate reuse probability within horizon.

Swap protocol: use two-phase demotion: first set chunk state to STAGED and start async upload to host; if a request touches a STAGED chunk, controller attempts optimistic re-stage to GPU; if upload completed, treat as a fast path read from pinned host buffer.
Backpressure integration: when host transfer backlog grows, controller selectively hard-demotes long-tail chunks and signals upper runtime to throttle non-critical batch formation.
KV index: store chunk residency metadata in a compact atomic table in device memory with a host mirror for diagnostics. Keep update path lock-free for hot paths using CAS-based state transitions.
Compatibility: fall back to existing LRU eviction if device does not support async DMA or if chunking is disabled via runtime flag.
Config knobs: chunk_size, reuse_horizon_ms, staged_timeout_ms, prefetch_budget_bytes, backpressure_thresholds
test_plan: Unit tests for chunk state machine transitions and CAS semantics
Microbench: replay recorded request traces (chat-heavy, short-turn completions, mixed) to measure host transfer bytes and swap frequency
Integration: run end-to-end inference on a dedicated pool with simulated noisy co-tenants to verify tail latency and throughput under evictions
Chaos: inject delayed DMA completions and OOM events to assert graceful fallback and no deadlocks
A/B rollout: feature flag rollout to 10% of runtime fleet; compare token-level cost, 95/99 latency, and swap volume metrics for 24h before wider release
metrics: host_transfer_bytes_per_hour: reduce by \u003e=15% on mixed workloads
comments: 2025-02-20 Aisha Patel: Created ticket after spike analysis. Spike showed repeated churn on small hotsets caused by scatter eviction under continuous batching. Proposed chunk rotation + deferred-swap as mitigation.

2025-02-24 Mateo Ruiz: Implemented simulator that replays 500K request tokens across three workload mixes. Early results: naive chunking (64KB) reduced swap ops by 22% but introduced a 3ms median latency bump due to occasional re-staging.
2025-02-26 Design review (L. Chen): Recommended adding STAGED state and optimistic re-stage path to reduce re-stage latency; also suggested emitting per-chunk reuse_estimate for offline tuning.
2025-02-28 Security notes (R. Okafor): No customer data flows change. Ensure host pinned buffers are zeroed on eviction; added to security checklist.

2025-03-01 Mateo Ruiz: Pushed prototype branch with basic chunk state machine and host transfer hooks (PR 1824). Need review from infra and perf teams. Observed edge-case when two concurrent batches attempt to re-stage the same chunk; added CAS retry loop fix.

2025-03-03 Perf follow-up (J. Nguyen): Ran 12-hour A/B synthetic on staging. Swap volume reduced by 19.6% and 99p latency improved by 8% on chat-heavy trace. Noted 95p latency increased by 4.2ms during bursty allocator contention; next steps: optimize CAS path and add local per-thread staging buffer pool.
